records.note: An archived ParcelPanel INPOSDOM page offered it to try. INPOSDOM's tracker answers it as a Singapore Post postal parcel that entered the Dominican Republic for the Puerto Plata office and is being processed at the head office.

A forum member says this registered letter was posted with INPOSDOM in the Dominican Republic for the United States. Its check digit holds; INPOSDOM's tracker only knows items arriving in the country.
